name: Standard AI Hiring Pipeline
description: Standard 7-step recruitment pipeline with LangGraph orchestration, RAG matching, human checkpoint, and automated interview/email generation.

nodes.name: Resume Parser
nodes.description: Extracts candidate details, skills, experience, and education from PDF resume.

nodes.name: Embedding Agent
nodes.description: Generates BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings and stores chunks in Qdrant.

nodes.name: Matching Agent
nodes.description: Calculates skill alignment against job criteria with RAG contextual analysis.

nodes.name: Shortlisting Agent
nodes.description: Determines candidate qualification (shortlisted, hold, rejected) using spec thresholds.

nodes.name: Human Approval
nodes.description: Pauses workflow for recruiter evaluation, approval, or rejection.

nodes.name: Interview Agent
nodes.description: Generates role-tailored technical questions, coding exercises, and scoring rubrics.

nodes.name: Email Agent
nodes.description: Generates personalized interview invite or polite rejection notice.
